start_message:
What bad luck...the safe is locked.

Luckily, you can crack the secret code!

First, there will be an explanation. You do not need to do anything yet.

Press the button to continue.
practice_message:
Well done!

But...the safe will not open that easily.

The digits have now been replaced by symbols.

Press the button for the new explanation.
run_message:
Press the number that matches the symbol as often as possible.

You have 1 minute.

Are you ready? Then press start.
baseline_instruction: you will see a digit, then choose the correct key
practice_instruction: you will see a symbol, find the matching number, then choose the correct key
end_screen:
This is the end of this task.
The next task will start automatically.
